mars-real.webp.description: Curiosity Mastcam mosaic, Rocknest, Gale crater, October–November 2012; raw camera color. Resized and converted to WebP; scene content preserved.

moon-real.webp.description: Apollo 17 photographic panorama of Taurus–Littrow. Resized and converted to WebP; no equipment or astronauts were removed.

hardware: Original NX1/NX2 team concepts. The procedural models and their rendered views are explanatory artwork, not engineering CAD, validated flight hardware or NASA equipment. The lunar backdrop is a visual setting, not a claim of validated lunar operation.
blueprints: Original team-generated design sheets preserved unchanged. Dimensions and performance annotations are proposed targets, not measured specifications.
render_pipeline: export-nx-geometry.mjs exports the same React concept geometry. render-nx-concepts.py produces exterior and illustrative internal views; shallow surface fittings and material treatment are illustrative.
